result.description: AI-powered web scraping platform that turns websites into structured data via scraper API, web search, workflows and bulk scraping.
result.auth_detail: REST API: per-account API token in x-api-token header (created in dashboard); marketplace endpoints use Authorization: Bearer token. OAuth 2.1 only on hosted MCP server, not REST.
result.access_detail: Gate audit: (1) No app review/publishing/partner status; each end user creates own API token in dashboard, so no gate. (2) Free plan exists, no credit card, with monthly tokens (docs conflict: 100 vs 1,000) and API Tokens listed for Free; docs do not explicitly say Free can call API, but nothing restricts API to paid. Paid Essential $99/mo for volume.
result.api_notes: Scraper API (HTML, Markdown, screenshot, JSON/brand), Web Search, plus Platform endpoints for workflows, bulk scraping cancel, results, analytics, subscription-accounts. Individual platform endpoint pages not fully read.

evidence.quote: Include your API token in the `x-api-token` HTTP header on every request:
Free costs nothing - no credit card required.
The Free plan includes 100 tokens per month with no credit card required.
All API endpoints require authentication using an API token passed in the `x-api-token` header.
Official MrScraper MCP server for retrieving web pages, web search, and account usage.
Connect to the hosted MCP endpoint through Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in.
MrScraper uses a token-based system for both usage and authentication.
